text: {"features":[{"name":"Role alignment","description":"How specifically the letter connects the applicant's background and goals to the actual mandate of this Google Information Security Engineering role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States generic interest in software or security with little evidence that the writer understands this team's focus or why it fits them."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References relevant themes such as backend work or security, but only loosely ties personal background to the team's stated responsibilities."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear match to the role by connecting prior work to at least one core responsibility such as security tooling, vulnerability response, or internal developer support."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Tailors the case to several parts of the posting, linking the writer's background to foundational security systems, automation, and collaboration around secure development."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a precise, convincing fit that reads as purpose-built for this team, explicitly matching the writer's experience and motivations to Google's security automation mandate, agentic tooling, and company-wide impact."}]},{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How strongly the letter shows motivation for working on central or foundational systems whose benefits multiply across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention broad organizational leverage or focuses only on the immediate tasks of the job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or impact in generic terms without connecting it to central platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in work whose benefits extend beyond a single product or team."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly values foundational or central infrastructure because improvements propagate to many engineers or users."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes multiplier effects a core reason for applying, clearly articulating how shared security tooling and response systems create outsized impact across the organization."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How thoughtfully the letter frames security work as an automation and systems problem rather than only as manual review or incident response.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats security interest at a high level without explaining how tooling or automation changes the work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or process improvement in passing but offers little insight into the security scaling problem it addresses."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that vulnerability handling or security response benefits from systems thinking and describes automation as a way to reduce repetitive work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a clear point of view on scaling scarce security expertise through tooling, triage, or variant analysis, showing understanding of why this matters operationally."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Frames the role with unusually strong systems insight, explaining security automation as a leverage problem and showing nuanced understanding of agents, routing, guardrails, auditing, or variant analysis."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How clearly the letter positions security tooling as a service that helps developers work securely by default.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not show awareness that the role serves internal developers or implies a primarily compliance-oriented stance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Acknowledges other engineers as users but says little about their constraints or how to help them."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses a clear desire to make secure practices easier for developers through better tools, workflows, or defaults."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong empathy for busy engineers by emphasizing low-friction workflows, usable tooling, and security embedded in everyday development."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a deeply internal-platform mindset, explicitly framing success as helping developers adopt secure behavior by default through carefully designed, respectful tooling."}]},{"name":"Software experience","description":"Strength of the letter's evidence of relevant experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Barely establishes the baseline, typically with only minimal tenure or limited examples of shipping and maintaining production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Clearly meets the minimum but with relatively narrow scope, modest service count, or limited ownership described."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid role-relevant experience, typically multiple years and several concrete responsibilities across testing, maintenance, and launches."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production maturity, usually through longer tenure or repeated ownership of several launched services with evidence of progression."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys extensive, durable engineering responsibility, with substantial tenure and clear stewardship of multiple production services through launch and ongoing operation."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes relevant experience building production systems in Go.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly as one language among many, with no indication of depth or production use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go has been used professionally but gives little sense of centrality or what was built with it."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes Go a clear working language in production and ties it to backend or service development."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or daily language and connects it to meaningful system design or operational responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep, role-specific Go credibility by portraying Go as the core implementation language for substantial back-end systems, guardrails, libraries, or other significant production responsibilities."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter establishes experience using Python for production services, automation, or analysis relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or only implies it indirectly."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python in a limited or generic way without showing meaningful responsibility or depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for tooling, automation, scripts, or services with clear professional relevance."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Python ownership across production-grade services or critical internal tooling, emphasizing reliability, testing, or extensibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major role-relevant strength, with sustained production use for automation, analysis, internal services, or AI-agent layers that other engineers depend on."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How much credible hands-on experience the letter shows in assessing systems for security risk.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals security interest or adjacent exposure but gives only vague or checklist-like assessment experience."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes real assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or attack-surface analysis at a practical level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial hands-on assessment experience with clear methods and follow-through such as validating fixes or reviewing systems not originally written by the applicant."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature security-assessment practice with specific, credible evidence of analyzing designs and implementations from an attacker's perspective and closing the loop on remediation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"How well the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, classification, routing, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention work on vulnerability handling or response automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References vulnerability work generally but not a concrete automation effort."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a credible automation project that improved how vulnerability reports were handled or prioritized."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of automation that classifies, deduplicates, routes, or otherwise materially reduces manual vulnerability-triage work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents end-to-end, high-leverage automation of vulnerability handling with clear mechanics and strong evidence that it significantly changed the team's workflow."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that coordinate autonomous or semi-autonomous agents with explicit controls.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic systems or autonomous-task tooling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or automation loosely without architectural detail or clear ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful work building agentic pipelines or task-decomposing systems with at least some detail about components or responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong design ownership of agentic architectures, including how agents act, how services constrain them, and how actions are bounded, logged, or audited."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates unusually strong, role-specific agentic systems experience, with clear architecture, control boundaries, and operational thinking that directly mirrors the job's agents-and-infrastructure mandate."}]},{"name":"Applied AI depth","description":"How much credible production experience the letter shows with AI systems relevant to this role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or language models in passing without showing shipped work or substantive lessons."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes real work building or integrating AI features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows solid applied-AI maturity by discussing evaluation, reliability, trustworthiness, or failure modes in addition to shipping features."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents strong, production-tested AI experience tightly relevant to the role, combining shipped functionality with careful engineering around evaluation, controls, and model behavior."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic strength","description":"How convincingly the letter demonstrates practical command of data structures and algorithms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of data-structure or algorithmic strength."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in general terms without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a concrete example of using a better structure or algorithm to solve a meaningful engineering problem."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong algorithmic fluency through specific, technically credible improvements to performance, scalability, or system tractability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates standout algorithmic depth by giving clear evidence of choosing or redesigning core structures or algorithms in a way that materially transformed an important system."}]},{"name":"Independent security engagement","description":"How much the letter shows self-driven development of security skill outside ordinary job responsibilities.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no evidence of security learning or practice beyond routine work experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a light external signal such as a baseline certification or casual security-practice activity."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Demonstrates ongoing external engagement through a credible certification, regular capture-the-flag participation, or another sustained security-practice signal."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong independent security development through a demanding hands-on credential, serious competition participation, or multiple solid external signals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional self-driven security commitment through elite competition results, a rigorous hands-on certification, or a combination of strong external signals that clearly deepen the applicant's security capability."}]},{"name":"Technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows substantial self-directed engineering outside assigned job duties through personal builds, open-source work, or maintenance responsibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of meaningful technical initiative beyond paid work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions minor tinkering or occasional small fixes with limited scope or sustained ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows consistent extra initiative through a modest personal project, occasional upstream contributions, or maintenance of a small tool."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial self-directed engineering through a significant side project or ongoing ownership of an open-source project used by others."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through both depth and persistence, such as maintaining a widely used open-source project, building a complex distributed system independently, or demonstrating similarly serious engineering ownership outside work."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How concrete and substantiated the letter's claims are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on generic assertions of ability with little concrete evidence, examples, or outcomes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specific claims but leaves most strengths vague or weakly supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several major claims with identifiable examples of systems, tasks, or results."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Regularly backs claims with concrete examples that make the applicant's role, methods, or impact easy to picture."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Nearly every major claim is grounded in precise, credible detail about what was built, how it worked, and what changed as a result."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter is organized into a clear, readable, persuasive progression rather than a disjointed list of points.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as fragmented or poorly structured, making the overall case hard to follow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but contains abrupt jumps, list-like sections, or weak transitions that blunt the argument."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Follows a clear progression from motivation to evidence to closing, with only minor roughness."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is smoothly organized, with each paragraph building a coherent and persuasive case for fit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially cohesive narrative in which motivation, evidence, and fit reinforce one another seamlessly from opening to close."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"How polished the letter is at the sentence level in spelling, grammar, punctuation, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that repeatedly distract the reader or undermine professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has several noticeable errors that do not destroy clarity but materially reduce polish."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has occasional minor errors or awkwardness while remaining clearly professional overall."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and polished with only rare, easy-to-ignore mistakes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished throughout."}]}]}
